name: regfish
description: Manage regfish domains, DNS records, DNSSEC and web hosting directly from Claude. Bundles the regfish MCP server and skills for safe DNS changes and domain diagnostics.

api_key.title: regfish API key
api_key.description: Create one in the regfish dashboard under Settings → Security → API keys. Paste the complete key; the '=' it contains is part of it. Pick a role that matches what you want Claude to do — 'DNS administrator' for record changes, 'read only' to look but not touch.
